errors.evidence: The y-axis is not labeled. The description invents a label "брой на анкетираните" (number of respondents).

The list of values does not correspond to the order of the categories presented on the x-axis. The correct sequence of values for the categories "Да, напълно", "Не мога да преценя", "Не, изобщо", "По-скоро да", "По-скоро не" is 12, 40, 1, 43, 9. The generated description has jumbled the last three values.

errors.text_span: Някои от стълбите са визуално подчертани с различна височина, според броя на анкетираните в съответната категория.
errors.evidence: This sentence is nonsensical. It describes the fundamental principle of a bar chart (using different heights for different values) as a form of "visual highlighting." There is no special highlighting on any of the bars, making the statement confusing and misleading.
